b: Apple TV’s Timberlake is a four-part documentary on Justin Timberlake’s three decades in the spotlight. “You wanna ask me about specific things? Let’s do it,” the singer says in the trailer, released today.

Directed by Fisher Stevens, the series is features never-before-seen archival footage and interviews with Timberlake’s family, friends, and collaborators. The trailer wades straight into the most scrutinized chapters of his life: his relationship with Britney Spears, the fallout from his 2004 Super Bowl halftime performance with Janet Jackson, and his DWI arrest in 2024.

Timberlake’s wife, Jessica Biel, and his mother both appear, as do Timbaland and Pharrell Williams, who produced the artist’s landmark solo albums Justified and FutureSex/LoveSounds. His most recent album, Everything I Thought It Was, dropped in 2024.
Timberlake premieres globally on Apple TV on December 11 with its first two episodes, followed by the third on December 18 and the finale on December 23.
